title: A superspace approach to AdS$_3$ string theory
summary: We carefully examine the Polyakov path integral for strings on $\text{AdS}_3$ in superspace, both for type II and heterotic superstrings. We construct a free-field realization of the supersymmetric $\text{SL}(2,\mathbb{R})$ WZW model which manifestly preserves worldsheet supersymmetry and use this free-field realization to construct spectrally-flowed vertex operators describing the emission of long strings in the bulk.
